"""Experimental CPU-JIT batch assembly of the unchanged Galerkin form.

The quadrature and singular corrections are extracted from the original
assembler, not reimplemented. Frequency and ray coefficients are dynamic JIT
inputs. All bins must pass the existing empirical table checks; otherwise the
entire frequency uses the original factored NumPy assembler. No production
module or paid cache is modified. This is not a material/geometry AD interface.
"""

import ast
import copy
import inspect
import runpy
import textwrap
from collections import namedtuple
from functools import partial
from pathlib import Path
from types import FunctionType

import jax
import jax.numpy as jnp
import numpy as np

from finiteblock_bem import kernels
from finiteblock_bem.galerkin import ROTATION, GalerkinOperators
from finiteblock_bem.galerkin_fast import PreparedGalerkinOperators

TOOLS = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
RAY = runpy.run_path(str(TOOLS / "ray_bessel_galerkin.py"))
FACTORED = runpy.run_path(str(TOOLS / "factored_galerkin.py"))
FIELDS = "vector measure px py dx dy nx ny angular log integral log_moment".split()
Batch = namedtuple("Batch", FIELDS)
Material = namedtuple("Material", "mu lam density cs cp")


def _jax_copy(original):
    return FunctionType(original.__code__, {**original.__globals__, "np": jnp}, original.__name__)


_series = _jax_copy(kernels._difference_derivatives_series)
_tensor = _jax_copy(kernels._tensor_from_radial)
_traction = _jax_copy(kernels.source_traction)


def _pair(z, coefficients, first_exponent):
    """All arguments are on the validated ray and inside accepted table bins."""
    mantissa, exponent = jnp.frexp(jnp.abs(z))
    ids = exponent - 1 - first_exponent
    x = 4 * mantissa - 3
    zero = jnp.zeros((2, *z.shape), dtype=jnp.complex128)

    def step(index, carry):
        a, b = carry
        k = coefficients.shape[-1] - 1 - index
        return coefficients[:, ids, k] + 2 * x * a - b, a

    a, b = jax.lax.fori_loop(0, coefficients.shape[-1] - 1, step, (zero, zero))
    value = (coefficients[:, ids, 0] + x * a - b) * jnp.exp(-z)[None]
    return value[0], value[1]


def _radial_code(original):
    """Retain radial algebra; translate the data-dependent series assignment."""
    tree = ast.parse(textwrap.dedent(inspect.getsource(original)))
    expected = {
        "ks, kp = complex(s) / material.cs, complex(s) / material.cp": "ks, kp = s / material.cs, s / material.cp",
        "k0s, k1s, k0p, k1p = kv(0, zs), kv(1, zs), kv(0, zp), kv(1, zp)": "k0s, k1s = _pair(zs, coefficients, first_exponent)\n"
        "k0p, k1p = _pair(zp, coefficients, first_exponent)",
        "if np.any(small):\n"
        "    d1, d2, d3 = _difference_derivatives_series(r[small], ks, kp)\n"
        "    f1[small], f2[small], f3[small] = d1, d2, d3":
        # The inactive auxiliary input avoids large-power overflow. Actual
        # separations and all active series inputs remain unchanged.
        "auxiliary_r = np.where(small, r, 0.1 / np.abs(ks))\n"
        "d1, d2, d3 = _series(auxiliary_r, ks, kp)\n"
        "f1 = np.where(small, d1, f1)\n"
        "f2 = np.where(small, d2, f2)\n"
        "f3 = np.where(small, d3, f3)",
    }
    body = tree.body[0].body
    for before, after in expected.items():
        target = ast.dump(ast.parse(before).body[0], include_attributes=False)
        positions = [
            i for i, n in enumerate(body) if ast.dump(n, include_attributes=False) == target
        ]
        if len(positions) != 1:
            raise ValueError("Original radial source changed; re-audit the JAX adapter")

        body[index : index + 1] = ast.parse(after).body
    function = tree.body[0]
    function.args.args.extend([ast.arg(arg="coefficients"), ast.arg(arg="first_exponent")])
    namespace = dict(np=jnp, _pair=_pair, _series=_series)

def _batch_code(original):

        "effective_s = s\n"
    ).body

    class Adapt(ast.NodeTransformer):

            if ast.unparse(node) == "b.self_pair":

                        ast.Name(id="coefficients", ctx=ast.Load()),
                        ast.Name(id="first_exponent", ctx=ast.Load()),
                    ]
                )
            return node

    footer[-1].body = [copy.deepcopy(reverse[0])]
    function = ast.parse(
        "def batch(b, s, material, coefficients, first_exponent, self_pair):\n    pass\n"
    ).body[0]
    function.body = (
        header
        + body
        + footer
        + ast.parse("return local_v, local_k, local_d.reshape(p, 4, 4), local_reverse").body
    )
    module = Adapt().visit(ast.Module(body=[function], type_ignores=[]))
    namespace = dict(
        np=jnp,
        _radial=_radial,
        _tensor_from_radial=_tensor,
        source_traction=_traction,
        ROTATION=jnp.asarray(ROTATION),
    )
    exec(compile(ast.fix_missing_locations(module), __file__ + "|batch", "exec"), namespace)
    return namespace["batch"]


_local_blocks = partial(jax.jit, static_argnames=("self_pair",))(
    _batch_code(PreparedGalerkinOperators.assemble)
)

    """Bounded per-batch JIT work, original host scatter, explicit fallback."""

        if not jax.config.x64_enabled:
            raise ValueError("The JAX Galerkin experiment requires JAX_ENABLE_X64=true")

        if not np.all(table.accepted):
            return (
                lambda: FACTORED["FactoredGalerkinOperators"].share(self.prepared).assemble(s),
                table,
            )
        material = Material(*(getattr(self.prepared.material, k) for k in Material._fields))
        # Uploaded once per frequency, not once per quadrature batch. np.asarray
        # below synchronizes every result, including first-call compilation.
        coefficients = jnp.asarray(table.coefficients)
        frequency = jnp.asarray(complex(s), dtype=jnp.complex128)
        first = jnp.asarray(table.first_exponent, dtype=jnp.int32)

        def evaluate():
            n = self.prepared.mesh.dofs
            vmat = np.zeros((n, n), complex)
            hmat, dmat = vmat.copy(), vmat.copy()
            for b in self.prepared.batches:
                args = Batch(*(getattr(b, k) for k in FIELDS))
                blocks = _local_blocks(args, frequency, material, coefficients, first, b.self_pair)
                local_v, local_k, local_d, local_reverse = [np.asarray(a) for a in blocks]
                np.add.at(vmat.ravel(), b.vindices, local_v)
                np.add.at(hmat.ravel(), b.hindices, local_k)
                np.add.at(dmat.ravel(), b.dindices, local_d)
                if not b.self_pair:
                    np.add.at(vmat.ravel(), (b.vindices % n) * n + b.vindices // n, local_v)
                    np.add.at(dmat.ravel(), (b.dindices % n) * n + b.dindices // n, local_d)
                    np.add.at(hmat.ravel(), b.reverse_hindices, local_reverse)
            hmat += 0.5 * self.prepared.mass
            return GalerkinOperators(vmat, hmat, dmat, self.prepared.mass)

        return evaluate, table

    def assemble(self, s=None):
        if s is None:
            return self.prepared.assemble(None)
        evaluate, _ = self.prepare(s)
        return evaluate()

    def statistics(self):
        return dict(
            backend="jax_x64_ray_batch_original_equations",
            whole_frequency_fallback_if_any_bin_rejected=True,
            original_host_scatter=True,
            original_small_argument_series_retained=True,
            dynamic_frequency_and_coefficients=True,
            fixed_table_material_or_geometry_derivatives_supported=False,
            uniform_error_certificate=False,
            production_backend_replaced=False,
        )

"""Independent raw, condensed and causal checks of the optional JIT adapter."""

import runpy
from pathlib import Path
from types import FunctionType

import numpy as np
import pytest

jax = pytest.importorskip("jax")
jax.config.update("jax_enable_x64", True)
TOOLS = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "tools"
JIT = runpy.run_path(str(TOOLS / "jax_ray_galerkin.py"))
VARIANT = JIT["JaxRayGalerkin"]
PAIRED_TESTS = runpy.run_path(str(TOOLS.parent / "tests/test_paired_ray_galerkin.py"))


@pytest.fixture(scope="module")
def transfer():
    return PAIRED_TESTS["transfer"].__wrapped__()


@pytest.mark.parametrize("s", [None, 175 + 0j, 175 + 31400j, 3e6 + 0j])
def test_original_raw_and_full_schur_gates(transfer, s):
    original = PAIRED_TESTS["test_both_full_raw_bodies_and_complete_schur_maps_keep_original_gates"]
    check = FunctionType(original.__code__, {**original.__globals__, "VARIANT": VARIANT})
    # The reused control additionally checks that original globals remain intact.
    check(transfer, s)


def test_whole_frequency_exact_fallback_when_bins_rejected(transfer):
    variant = VARIANT(transfer.prepared[0], degree=8, check_rtol=1e-30)
    evaluate, table = variant.prepare(175 + 31400j)
    assert not np.any(table.accepted)
    exact = (
        JIT["FACTORED"]["FactoredGalerkinOperators"]
        .share(transfer.prepared[0])
        .assemble(175 + 31400j)
    )
    actual = evaluate()
    for name in ["single_layer", "trace_double_layer", "hypersingular"]:
        np.testing.assert_array_equal(getattr(actual, name), getattr(exact, name))


def test_complete_causal_history_and_future_transpose():
    original = PAIRED_TESTS["test_all_small_contour_causal_weights_forward_and_future_transpose"]
    check = FunctionType(original.__code__, {**original.__globals__, "VARIANT": VARIANT})
    check()


def test_changed_radial_source_requires_reaudit():
    def incompatible(r, s, material):
        return r

    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="re-audit"):
        JIT["_radial_code"](incompatible)

import json

    begun = perf_counter()
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(add_help=False)
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
    args, _ = parser.parse_known_args()
    jit = runpy.run_path(str(TOOLS / "jax_ray_galerkin.py"))
    benchmark = runpy.run_path(str(TOOLS / "benchmark_ray_bessel.py"))
    imports_seconds = perf_counter() - begun
    try:
        benchmark["main"](
            assembler=jit["JaxRayGalerkin"],
            extra_sources=(Path(__file__), TOOLS / "jax_ray_galerkin.py"),
            backend_name="jax_x64_ray_batch_original_equations",
        )
    finally:
        if args.output.is_dir():
            record = dict(
                import_and_jax_startup_seconds=imports_seconds,
                wrapper_seconds_including_imports=perf_counter() - begun,
                compiled_signatures=jit["COMPILED_SIGNATURES"],

"""Complete short two-body sliding/initialized-AD control for paired kernels.

Both backends assemble every physical Radau mode on the same complete small
contour. The shared healed preload uses the original static body operator.
The accelerated actuator is an explicit diagnostic, not event-16 loading.
This checks backend integration; it is not full-event accuracy or timing.
"""

import argparse
import json
import runpy
from dataclasses import asdict
from pathlib import Path
from time import perf_counter

import numpy as np
from threadpoolctl import threadpool_limits

from finiteblock_bem.cq import BoundaryHistory, plan_cq
from finiteblock_bem.io import environment_record, fingerprint, write_json
from finiteblock_bem.nodal import load_nodal_model, nodal_body_stiffness

TOOLS = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
CASE = TOOLS.parent / "src/finiteblock_bem/resources/cases/pmma_event16.toml"
SEED = CASE.parent.parent / "data/ev16_restart_float64.npz"


def relative_error(actual, exact):
    denominator = np.linalg.norm(exact)
    error = np.linalg.norm(actual - exact)
    return float(error / denominator) if denominator else (0.0 if error == 0 else None)


def mixed_error(actual, exact, *, rtol=1e-7, atol=1e-18):
    return float(np.max(abs(actual - exact) / (atol + rtol * np.maximum(abs(actual), abs(exact)))))


def main(*, assembler=None, backend_name="paired_ray_bessel_and_factored_contractions"):
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    p.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
    args = p.parse_args()
    output = args.output.resolve()
    if output.exists() or output.is_relative_to(Path("/Volumes/Gauss-T7/tatva").resolve()):
        raise ValueError("Require fresh owned diagnostic output outside original Tatva")
    output.mkdir(parents=True)
    begun = perf_counter()
    import jax

    jax.config.update("jax_enable_x64", True)
    frozen = {str(path.resolve()): fingerprint(path) for path in [*TOOLS.glob("*.py"), CASE, SEED]}
    environment = environment_record(CASE)

    def verify():
        if any(fingerprint(path) != value for path, value in frozen.items()) or (
            environment_record(CASE) != environment
        ):
            raise ValueError("Original or candidate numerical inputs changed")

    try:
        with threadpool_limits(limits=1, user_api="blas"):
            result = experiment(output, frozen, environment, begun, assembler=assembler)
        verify()
        result.update(
            total_seconds_including_all_controls=perf_counter() - begun,
            frozen_inputs_sha256=frozen,
            environment=environment,
            backend=backend_name,
            legacy_variant_key="paired",
            original_tatva_readonly=True,
            full_original_event_reproduced=False,
            same_accuracy_fem_advantage_verified=False,
            independent_full_trajectory_finite_difference_verified=False,
            scope="Complete 128-step coarse accelerated sliding diagnostic, fixed bulk and recorded loading; selected healed-static/transient branches. Not original-rate event 16, fine/full event convergence, stopping-time/material/geometry AD, or a uniform kernel certificate.",
        )
        write_json(output / "summary.json", result)
        print(json.dumps({k: v for k, v in result.items() if k.endswith("errors")}), flush=True)
    except BaseException as error:
        write_json(
            output / "failure.json",
            dict(error=repr(error), seconds=perf_counter() - begun, completed=False),
        )
        raise


def experiment(output, frozen, environment, begun, *, assembler=None):
    ray = runpy.run_path(str(TOOLS / "paired_ray_galerkin.py"))
    rk = runpy.run_path(str(TOOLS / "radau_experiment.py"))
    modes = runpy.run_path(str(TOOLS / "radau_raw_sampling.py"))["lower_half_radau_modes"]
    compact = runpy.run_path(str(TOOLS / "compact_radau_storage.py"))
    simulate = runpy.run_path(str(TOOLS / "simulate_compact_radau.py"))["simulate_stages"]
    refined = runpy.run_path(str(TOOLS / "refined_contact.py"))
    body = runpy.run_path(str(TOOLS / "uncondensed_static_contact.py"))
    ad = runpy.run_path(str(TOOLS / "initialized_radau_adjoint.py"))["initialized_gradient"]
    model = load_nodal_model(
        CASE,
        max_panel_length=160,
        contact_panel_length=160,
        contact_end_length=160,
        corner_panel_length=160,
    )
    model, seed_record = runpy.run_path(str(TOOLS / "restart_seed_experiment.py"))[
        "apply_restart_seed"
    ](model, SEED)
    transfer = runpy.run_path(str(TOOLS / "trace_schur_experiment.py"))["TraceSchurTransfer"](
        model, quadrature=12
    )
    plan = plan_cq(transfer.dofs, 2e-6, 128, max_memory_mb=512)
    law, con = model.reference.contact, model.constraints
    spring = model.reference.spring_stiffness * con.platen_width
    diagonal = np.diag(
        np.r_[
            con.contact_weights * law.normal_penalty,
            con.contact_weights * law.tangential_penalty,
            spring,
        ]
    )
    factory = ray["PairedRayGalerkin"] if assembler is None else assembler
    providers = {
        "original": transfer.prepared,
        "paired": [factory(a) for a in transfer.prepared],
    }
    write_json(
        output / "preflight.json",
        dict(
            plan=asdict(plan),
            frozen_inputs_sha256=frozen,
            environment=environment,
            seed=seed_record,
            mesh=dict(h=160, contact_h=160, contact_end_h=160, corner_h=160, quadrature=12),
            diagnostic_actuator_rate_mm_per_s=7812.5,
            original_actuator_rate_mm_per_s=model.reference.actuator_rate,
            shared_original_static_preload=True,
        ),
    )
    raw_max, schur_max = 0.0, 0.0

    def impedances(s):
        nonlocal raw_max, schur_max
        operators = {name: [a.assemble(s) for a in group] for name, group in providers.items()}
        for actual, exact in zip(operators["paired"], operators["original"], strict=True):
            for field in ["single_layer", "trace_double_layer", "hypersingular"]:
                x, y = getattr(actual, field), getattr(exact, field)
                value = float(np.linalg.norm(x - y) / (1e-14 + 1e-11 * np.linalg.norm(y)))
                raw_max = max(raw_max, value)
                if not np.isfinite(value) or value > 1:
                    raise ValueError("Complete small-contour raw gate failed")
        maps = {
            name: transfer.evaluate_operators(op, reconstruction=True)
            for name, op in operators.items()
        }
        for x, y in zip(maps["paired"], maps["original"], strict=True):
            for order in [None, np.inf]:
                value = float(np.linalg.norm(x - y, ord=order) / np.linalg.norm(y, ord=order))
                schur_max = max(schur_max, value)
                if not np.isfinite(value) or value > 1e-8:
                    raise ValueError("Complete small-contour Schur gate failed")
        return {name: value[0] for name, value in maps.items()}

    spectra = {
        name: [np.empty((plan.fft_size // 2 + 1, plan.dofs, plan.dofs), complex) for _ in range(2)]
        for name in providers
    }
    for index in range(plan.fft_size // 2 + 1):
        zeta = plan.radius * np.exp(-2j * np.pi * index / plan.fft_size)
        a, b = modes(zeta, plan.dt)
        za, zb = impedances(a), impedances(b)
        for name, families in spectra.items():
            la, lb = np.linalg.inv(za[name] + diagonal), np.linalg.inv(zb[name] + diagonal)
            families[0][index] = (b * la - a * lb) / (b - a)
            families[1][index] = (lb - la) / ((b - a) * plan.dt)
        write_json(
            output / "progress.json",
            dict(phase="complete_contour", index=index, total=plan.fft_size // 2 + 1),
        )
    contour_seconds = perf_counter() - begun
    # Use the actual coupled RK symbol, independently of contour interpolation.
    impedances0 = {}
    zero_cache = {}

    def at_zero(s, name):
        if s not in zero_cache:
            zero_cache[s] = impedances(s)
        return zero_cache[s][name]

    for name in providers:
        impedances0[name] = rk["matrix_function"](
            lambda s, name=name: at_zero(s, name), rk["radau_symbol"](0) / plan.dt
        ).real
    y = model.reference.moving.starts[model.moving_contact, 1]
    space = refined["ContactQuadrature"].build(y, 1)
    reduction = refined["reduce_static_trace"](model, nodal_body_stiffness(model, quadrature=12))
    lift = body["initialize_uncondensed_contact"](model, space, reduction, model.restart)
    reference = refined["dynamic_refined_reference"](
        model, space, lift, np.zeros((plan.dofs, plan.dofs))
    )
    sensitivity = runpy.run_path(str(TOOLS / "uncondensed_static_contact_ad.py"))[
        "uncondensed_static_parameter_jacobian"
    ](model, space, reduction, model.restart, lift)
    initial_residual = reference.evaluate(
        np.zeros(plan.dofs),
        np.zeros(plan.dofs),
        model.reference.normal_pressure,
        model.reference.restart_actuator,
        lift.state,
        jacobian=False,
    )[0]
    initial_force = initial_residual * reference.constraints.reduced_weights
    if np.max(abs(initial_residual)) > 1e-7:
        raise ValueError("Original measured static root failed")
    clock = np.zeros((plan.steps + 1, 2))
    clock[1:] = (np.arange(plan.steps)[:, None] + rk["C"]) * plan.dt
    ramp = model.reference.restart_actuator + 7812.5 * clock
    dp, da = runpy.run_path(str(TOOLS / "check_compact_radau_ad.py"))["verification_directions"](
        plan.steps
    )
    outputs, duality, complete_weights = {}, {}, {}
    for name, families in spectra.items():
        write_json(output / "progress.json", dict(phase="primal_and_initialized_ad", backend=name))
        w0, w1, wrap = rk["invert_compact_spectrum"](*families, plan)
        complete_weights[name] = rk["expand_compact_weights"](w0, w1, wrap)
        histories = BoundaryHistory(plan, w0), BoundaryHistory(plan, w1)
        elastic = compact["causal_compact_startup"](
            families[0][:, :, -1], families[1][:, :, -1], wrap[:, -1], plan, spring * 7812.5 * clock
        )
        result, stages = simulate(
            reference,
            lift.state,
            *histories,
            wrap,
            impedances0[name],
            elastic,
            clock,
            ramp,
            diagnostic=True,
            segment_substeps=(8, 16),
            recover=True,
            kinetic_seed=True,
            initial_residual_force=initial_force,
        )
        if np.max(stages["response"][-1, :, 1, 3]) <= law.characteristic_slip:
            raise ValueError("Control did not reach nontrivial slip weakening")
        arguments = (reference, *histories, wrap, impedances0[name], stages)
        reverse = ad("reverse_gradient", sensitivity, *arguments, segment_substeps=(8, 16))
        forward = ad(
            "forward_directions", sensitivity, *arguments, dp, da, segment_substeps=(8, 16)
        )
        dual = reverse["gradient"] @ dp + np.einsum("ts,tsp->p", reverse["actuator_gradient"], da)
        jvp = np.asarray(forward["objective_directional_derivative"])
        duality[name] = mixed_error(jvp, dual)
        if not np.isfinite(duality[name]) or duality[name] > 1:
            raise ValueError("Initialized VJP/JVP gate failed")
        outputs[name] = dict(
            displacement=stages["displacement"],
            response=stages["response"],
            gradient=reverse["gradient"],
            actuator_gradient=reverse["actuator_gradient"],
            jvp=jvp,
        )
        np.savez(output / f"{name}-arrays.npz", **outputs[name])
        write_json(output / f"{name}-diagnostics.json", result.diagnostics)
    errors = {
        k: relative_error(outputs["paired"][k], outputs["original"][k]) for k in outputs["paired"]
    }
    gradient_errors = {
        k: mixed_error(outputs["paired"][k], outputs["original"][k])
        for k in ["gradient", "actuator_gradient", "jvp"]
    }
    for k in ["displacement", "response"]:
        if errors[k] is None or not np.isfinite(errors[k]) or errors[k] > 1e-8:
            raise ValueError("Complete saved-stage primal gate failed")
    if any(not np.isfinite(v) or v > 1 for v in gradient_errors.values()):
        raise ValueError("Complete initialized backend-gradient gate failed")
    weight_error = relative_error(complete_weights["paired"], complete_weights["original"])
    if weight_error is None or weight_error > 1e-9:
        raise ValueError("Complete causal weight gate failed")
    return dict(
        status="passed_complete_coarse_sliding_and_selected_initialized_ad_backend_control",
        plan=asdict(plan),
        all_physical_contour_modes_checked=True,
        physical_contour_mode_evaluations=2 * (plan.fft_size // 2 + 1),
        additional_unique_lag_zero_modes=len(zero_cache),
        maximum_raw_mixed_normalized_error=raw_max,
        maximum_schur_relative_error=schur_max,
        complete_causal_weight_relative_error=weight_error,
        saved_stage_relative_errors=errors,
        initialized_gradient_mixed_normalized_errors=gradient_errors,
        initialized_jvp_vjp_mixed_normalized_errors=duality,
        final_max_cumulative_slip_mm={
            name: float(np.max(value["response"][-1, :, 1, 3])) for name, value in outputs.items()
        },
        contour_seconds_including_initial_preparation=contour_seconds,
        all_history_retained=True,
        fitted_time_shift_s=0,
    )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Alternate full original and ray-table Galerkin assemblies at actual CQ modes.

All three raw operators and both complete Schur maps are audited. Table
construction is charged on every approximate assembly. This is a sampled
assembly benchmark, not complete nonlinear event timing or an FEM advantage.
"""

import argparse
import json
import runpy
from dataclasses import asdict
from pathlib import Path
from statistics import median
from time import perf_counter

import numpy as np
from threadpoolctl import threadpool_limits

from finiteblock_bem.cq import plan_cq
from finiteblock_bem.galerkin_fast import prepared_geometry_bytes
from finiteblock_bem.io import environment_record, fingerprint, write_json
from finiteblock_bem.nodal import load_nodal_model

TOOLS = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
RAY = runpy.run_path(str(TOOLS / "ray_bessel_galerkin.py"))
SCHUR = runpy.run_path(str(TOOLS / "trace_schur_experiment.py"))["TraceSchurTransfer"]
MODES = runpy.run_path(str(TOOLS / "radau_raw_sampling.py"))["lower_half_radau_modes"]
ERRORS = runpy.run_path(str(TOOLS / "benchmark_factored_galerkin.py"))["errors"]
FIELDS = ["single_layer", "trace_double_layer", "hypersingular"]


def main(*, assembler=None, extra_sources=(), backend_name="ray_bessel"):
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    p.add_argument("case", type=Path)
    p.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
    p.add_argument("--h", type=float, default=10)
    p.add_argument("--contact-h", type=float, default=2)
    p.add_argument("--contact-end-h", type=float, default=0.015625)
    p.add_argument("--corner-h", type=float, default=0.015625)
    p.add_argument("--quadrature", type=int, default=12)
    p.add_argument("--dt", type=float, default=2e-6)
    p.add_argument("--duration", type=float, default=0.045)
    p.add_argument("--indices", nargs="+", type=int, default=[0, 655])
    p.add_argument("--branches", nargs="+", type=int, default=[0])
    p.add_argument("--include-fast-zero", action="store_true")
    p.add_argument("--degree", type=int, default=24)
    p.add_argument("--repeats", type=int, default=2)
    p.add_argument("--max-memory-mb", type=float, default=12288)
    args = p.parse_args()
    begun, output = perf_counter(), args.output.resolve()
    if (
        output.exists()
        or output.is_relative_to(Path("/Volumes/Gauss-T7/tatva").resolve())
        or args.repeats < 2
        or args.branches != sorted(set(args.branches))
        or any(b not in [0, 1] for b in args.branches)
        or args.indices != sorted(set(args.indices))
        or not np.isfinite(args.max_memory_mb)
        or args.max_memory_mb <= 0
    ):
        raise ValueError("Require fresh output, distinct physical modes, repeats and finite budget")
    model = load_nodal_model(
        args.case,
        max_panel_length=args.h,
        contact_panel_length=args.contact_h,
        contact_end_length=args.contact_end_h,
        corner_panel_length=args.corner_h,
    )
    plan = plan_cq(
        2 * len(model.moving_contact) + 1,
        args.dt,
        round(args.duration / args.dt),
        max_memory_mb=1e9,
        disk_spectrum=True,
    )
    if any(k < 0 or k > plan.fft_size // 2 for k in args.indices):
        raise ValueError("Frequency index is outside the original Radau plan")
    meshes = [model.reference.moving, model.reference.stationary]
    peak = sum(prepared_geometry_bytes(m, args.quadrature) for m in meshes)
    peak += 32 * (model.constraints.size**2 + sum(m.dofs**2 for m in meshes)) * 16
    peak += 512 * 1024**2
    if peak > args.max_memory_mb * 1024**2:
        raise ValueError("Shared geometry/solver estimate exceeds explicit array budget")
    paths = [
        Path(__file__),
        TOOLS / "ray_bessel_galerkin.py",
        TOOLS / "trace_schur_experiment.py",
        TOOLS / "schur_condensation_experiment.py",
        TOOLS / "radau_raw_sampling.py",
        TOOLS / "benchmark_factored_galerkin.py",
        TOOLS / "factored_galerkin.py",
        args.case,
        *extra_sources,
    ]
    frozen = {str(v.resolve()): fingerprint(v) for v in paths}
    environment = environment_record(args.case)
    output.mkdir(parents=True)
    write_json(
        output / "preflight.json",
        dict(
            plan=asdict(plan),
            estimated_array_bytes=peak,
            arguments=vars(args) | {"case": str(args.case.resolve()), "output": str(output)},
            frozen_inputs_sha256=frozen,
            environment=environment,
            raw_rtol=1e-11,
            raw_atol=1e-14,
            output_relative_tolerance=1e-8,
            backend=backend_name,
            timing_variant_key="ray",
        ),
    )
    samples = []
    with threadpool_limits(limits=1, user_api="blas"):
        start = perf_counter()
        reference = SCHUR(model, quadrature=args.quadrature)
        original_preparation = perf_counter() - start
        start = perf_counter()
        factory = RAY["RayBesselGalerkin"] if assembler is None else assembler
        variants = [factory(a, degree=args.degree) for a in reference.prepared]
        variant_preparation = perf_counter() - start
        modes = [(i, b) for i in args.indices for b in args.branches]
        if args.include_fast_zero and (0, 1) not in modes:
            modes.append((0, 1))
        for index, branch in modes:
            s = MODES(plan.radius * np.exp(-2j * np.pi * index / plan.fft_size), plan.dt)[branch]
            times = {
                key: []
                for key in [
                    "original_assembly",
                    "ray_table_preparation",
                    "ray_assembly",
                    "ray_preparation_and_assembly",
                    "original_condensation",
                    "ray_condensation",
                ]
            }
            attempts = []
            for repeat in range(args.repeats):
                operators, maps, tables = {}, {}, []
                order = ["original", "ray"] if repeat % 2 == 0 else ["ray", "original"]
                for name in order:
                    write_json(
                        output / "live.json",
                        dict(index=index, branch=branch, repeat=repeat, method=name),
                    )
                    if name == "ray":
                        start = perf_counter()
                        prepared = [a.prepare(s) for a in variants]
                        preparation = perf_counter() - start
                        times["ray_table_preparation"].append(preparation)
                        tables = [table.statistics() for _, table in prepared]
                    start = perf_counter()
                    operators[name] = (
                        [a.assemble(s) for a in reference.prepared]
                        if name == "original"
                        else [evaluate() for evaluate, _ in prepared]
                    )
                    elapsed = perf_counter() - start
                    times[name + "_assembly"].append(elapsed)
                    if name == "ray":
                        times["ray_preparation_and_assembly"].append(elapsed + preparation)
                    start = perf_counter()
                    maps[name] = reference.evaluate_operators(operators[name], reconstruction=True)
                    times[name + "_condensation"].append(perf_counter() - start)
                checks, passed = [], True
                for body in range(2):
                    for field in FIELDS:
                        a, b = (
                            getattr(operators[name][body], field) for name in ["ray", "original"]
                        )
                        report = ERRORS(a, b)
                        normalized = float(
                            np.linalg.norm(a - b) / (1e-14 + 1e-11 * np.linalg.norm(b))
                        )
                        checks.append(
                            dict(
                                body=body,
                                field=field,
                                mixed_tolerance_normalized=normalized,
                                **report,
                            )
                        )
                        passed &= normalized <= 1
                for field, a, b in zip(
                    ["impedance", "full_boundary_reconstruction"],
                    maps["ray"],
                    maps["original"],
                    strict=True,
                ):
                    report = ERRORS(a, b)
                    checks.append(dict(field=field, **report))
                    passed &= max(report["relative_frobenius"], report["relative_inf"]) <= 1e-8
                attempts.append(
                    dict(repeat=repeat, checks=checks, tables=tables, all_gates_passed=bool(passed))
                )
                write_json(
                    output / "attempt-progress.json",
                    dict(index=index, branch=branch, times=times, attempts=attempts),
                )
                if not passed:
                    np.savez_compressed(
                        output / "failed-operators.npz",
                        **{
                            f"{name}_{body}_{field}": getattr(operators[name][body], field)
                            for name in operators
                            for body in range(2)
                            for field in FIELDS
                        },
                    )
                    raise ValueError(
                        "Original raw/Schur gate failed; failed operators and costs saved"
                    )
                del operators, maps, prepared
            medians = {k: median(v) for k, v in times.items()}
            samples.append(
                dict(
                    index=index,
                    branch=branch,
                    s_real=float(s.real),
                    s_imag=float(s.imag),
                    times=times,
                    medians=medians,
                    assembly_speed_ratio_including_tables=medians["original_assembly"]
                    / medians["ray_preparation_and_assembly"],
                    attempts=attempts,
                )
            )
            write_json(output / "progress.json", dict(samples=samples))

"""Experimental frequency-local scaled-Bessel interpolation on a single ray.

The table interpolates exp(z)*K_0(z) and exp(z)*K_1(z), not the oscillatory
exponential. Independent off-grid checks and coefficient tails are empirical
acceptance tests, not a uniform error certificate. Rejected bins and arguments
outside the positive-real ray domain use the original SciPy implementation.
Only private copies of the original radial/assembly globals are changed.
"""

from dataclasses import dataclass
from types import FunctionType

import numpy as np
from scipy.fft import dct
from scipy.special import kv, kve

from finiteblock_bem import kernels
from finiteblock_bem.galerkin_fast import PreparedGalerkinOperators


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class RayBesselTable:
    direction: complex
    first_exponent: int
    coefficients: np.ndarray
    accepted: np.ndarray
    checks: tuple
    check_rtol: float

    @classmethod
    def prepare(cls, s, minimum, maximum, *, degree=24, check_rtol=5e-14):
        """Freeze dyadic intervals covering the declared positive radius domain."""
        if (
            not np.isfinite(s)
            or np.real(s) <= 0
            or not np.isfinite(minimum)
            or not np.isfinite(maximum)
            or not 0 < minimum <= maximum
            or not isinstance(degree, int)
            or not 8 <= degree <= 64
            or not np.isfinite(check_rtol)
            or not 0 < check_rtol <= 1e-11
        ):
            raise ValueError("Require a finite right-half-plane ray and bounded positive domain")
        direction = complex(s) / abs(s)
        first = int(np.frexp(minimum)[1]) - 1
        last = int(np.frexp(maximum)[1]) - 1
        if first < -900 or last > 900 or last - first > 256:
            raise ValueError("Bessel table exponent range exceeds the explicit finite budget")
        count = degree + 1
        x = np.cos(np.pi * (np.arange(count) + 0.5) / count)
        # These nodes differ from every interpolation node; include bin seams.
        check_x = np.r_[
            -1.0,
            0.0,
            1.0,
            np.cos(np.pi * (np.arange(2 * count + 3) + 0.37) / (2 * count + 3)),
        ]
        coefficients = np.empty((2, last - first + 1, count), complex)
        accepted = np.zeros(last - first + 1, bool)
        checks = []
        for i, exponent in enumerate(range(first, last + 1)):
            lo = np.ldexp(1.0, exponent)
            z = direction * (lo * (1.5 + 0.5 * x))
            check_z = direction * (lo * (1.5 + 0.5 * check_x))
            record = []
            for order in [0, 1]:
                values = kve(order, z)
                c = dct(values, type=2) / count
                c[0] *= 0.5
                coefficients[order, i] = c
                reference = kve(order, check_z)
                actual = np.polynomial.chebyshev.chebval(check_x, c)
                with np.errstate(divide="ignore", invalid="ignore"):
                    error = float(np.max(abs(actual - reference) / abs(reference)))
                    tail = float(np.sum(abs(c[-4:])) / np.min(abs(reference)))
                finite = all(np.all(np.isfinite(a)) for a in [values, c, reference, actual])
                record.append((error, tail, finite and error <= check_rtol and tail <= check_rtol))
            accepted[i] = all(v[2] for v in record)
            checks.append((exponent, *[v for item in record for v in item]))
        coefficients.flags.writeable = accepted.flags.writeable = False
        return cls(direction, first, coefficients, accepted, tuple(checks), check_rtol)

    def _coordinates(self, z):
        radius = abs(z)
        mantissa, exponent = np.frexp(radius)
        bins = exponent.astype(np.int64) - 1 - self.first_exponent
        # frexp's treatment of nonfinite inputs must not index the coefficient table.
        in_range = np.isfinite(z) & (radius > 0) & (bins >= 0) & (bins < len(self.accepted))
        ids = np.clip(bins, 0, len(self.accepted) - 1)
        rotated = z * self.direction.conjugate()
        # The tolerance admits multiplication roundoff on this ray only.
        on_ray = (rotated.real > 0) & (abs(rotated.imag) <= 8 * np.finfo(float).eps * radius)
        use = in_range & on_ray & self.accepted[ids]
        return use, ids, 4 * mantissa - 3

    def __call__(self, order, z):
        if np.ndim(order) or order not in (0, 1):
            return kv(order, z)
        original = np.asarray(z)
        # Preserve SciPy's real-valued scalar/array convention as an exact fallback.
        if not np.iscomplexobj(original):
            return kv(order, z)
        array = np.asarray(z, complex)
        flat = array.reshape(-1)
        use, bins, x = self._coordinates(flat)
        result = np.empty_like(flat)
        result[~use] = kv(order, flat[~use])
        if np.any(use):
            ids, coordinate = bins[use], x[use]
            c = self.coefficients[int(order)]
            # Batched Clenshaw recurrence without a degree-by-all-points allocation.
            a = np.zeros(len(ids), complex)
            b = np.zeros_like(a)
            for k in range(c.shape[-1] - 1, 0, -1):
                a, b = c[ids, k] + 2 * coordinate * a - b, a
            result[use] = (c[ids, 0] + coordinate * a - b) * np.exp(-flat[use])
        value = result.reshape(array.shape)
        return value[()] if array.ndim == 0 else value

    def statistics(self):
        return dict(
            first_exponent=self.first_exponent,
            bins=len(self.accepted),
            accepted_bins=int(np.count_nonzero(self.accepted)),
            degree=self.coefficients.shape[-1] - 1,
            table_bytes=self.coefficients.nbytes + self.accepted.nbytes,
            offgrid_relative_tolerance=self.check_rtol,
            bin_checks=[
                dict(
                    exponent=v[0],
                    k0_relative_error=v[1] if np.isfinite(v[1]) else None,
                    k0_relative_tail=v[2] if np.isfinite(v[2]) else None,
                    k0_accepted=v[3],
                    k1_relative_error=v[4] if np.isfinite(v[4]) else None,
                    k1_relative_tail=v[5] if np.isfinite(v[5]) else None,
                    k1_accepted=v[6],
                )
                for v in self.checks
            ],
            uniform_error_certificate=False,
        )


class RayBesselGalerkin:
    """Share immutable quadrature and freeze a private Bessel table per assembly."""

    def __init__(self, prepared, *, degree=24, check_rtol=5e-14):
        if type(prepared) is not PreparedGalerkinOperators:
            raise ValueError("Require the original prepared Galerkin assembler")
        if prepared.mass.flags.writeable or any(
            v.flags.writeable
            for batch in prepared.batches
            for v in vars(batch).values()
            if isinstance(v, np.ndarray)
        ):
            raise ValueError("Shared Galerkin geometry must be immutable")
        minimum, maximum = np.inf, 0.0
        for batch in prepared.batches:
            radius = np.linalg.norm(batch.vector, axis=-1)
            minimum, maximum = min(minimum, float(radius.min())), max(maximum, float(radius.max()))
        if not np.isfinite(minimum) or minimum <= 0:
            raise ValueError("Quadrature must have finite strictly positive separations")
        self.prepared, self.minimum, self.maximum = prepared, minimum, maximum
        self.degree, self.check_rtol = degree, check_rtol

    def prepare(self, s):
        material = self.prepared.material
        # Outward padding covers rounding in ks*r versus |s|*r/cs at dyadic seams.
        padding = 32 * np.finfo(float).eps
        table = RayBesselTable.prepare(
            s,
            abs(s) * self.minimum / max(material.cs, material.cp) * (1 - padding),
            abs(s) * self.maximum / min(material.cs, material.cp) * (1 + padding),
            degree=self.degree,
            check_rtol=self.check_rtol,
        )
        original = kernels._radial
        radial = FunctionType(
            original.__code__, {**original.__globals__, "kv": table}, original.__name__
        )
        radial.__defaults__, radial.__kwdefaults__ = original.__defaults__, original.__kwdefaults__
        original = PreparedGalerkinOperators.assemble
        assemble = FunctionType(
            original.__code__, {**original.__globals__, "_radial": radial}, original.__name__
        )
        assemble.__defaults__ = original.__defaults__

        def evaluate():
            return assemble(self.prepared, s)

        return evaluate, table

    def assemble(self, s=None):
        if s is None:
            return self.prepared.assemble(None)
        evaluate, _ = self.prepare(s)
        return evaluate()

"""Laplace-domain Green tensor for the 2D Navier elastodynamic equation.

For Re(s)>0, (rho*s**2 - mu*Delta - (lambda+mu)*grad div) G = I*delta.
Writing phi_k=K0(k*r)/(2*pi), k_s=s/c_s and k_p=s/c_p,

    G = (phi_s*I - Hessian(phi_s-phi_p)/k_s**2) / mu.

Source derivatives use r_vector = source - target. The double-layer kernel
is the source traction of each row of G, with the SOURCE outward normal.
Small arguments use the analytic K0 series before differentiation, avoiding
subtraction of the common 1/r terms in k_s*K1 and k_p*K1.
"""

import math

import numpy as np
from scipy.special import kv

from .material import ElasticMaterial


def _difference_derivatives_series(r, ks, kp):
    """First three radial derivatives of K0(ks*r)-K0(kp*r)."""
    f1 = np.zeros_like(r, dtype=complex)
    f2 = np.zeros_like(r, dtype=complex)
    f3 = np.zeros_like(r, dtype=complex)
    harmonic = 0.0
    log_r = np.log(r)
    for k in range(1, 10):
        harmonic += 1 / k
        n = 2 * k
        cs = (ks / 2) ** n / math.factorial(k) ** 2
        cp = (kp / 2) ** n / math.factorial(k) ** 2
        a = cs * (harmonic - np.euler_gamma - np.log(ks / 2))
        a -= cp * (harmonic - np.euler_gamma - np.log(kp / 2))
        b = -(cs - cp)
        value = a + b * log_r
        f1 += r ** (n - 1) * (n * value + b)
        f2 += r ** (n - 2) * (n * (n - 1) * value + (2 * n - 1) * b)
        f3 += r ** (n - 3) * (n * (n - 1) * (n - 2) * value + (3 * n * n - 6 * n + 2) * b)
    return f1, f2, f3


def _radial(r, s, material, *, scalars=False):
    ks, kp = complex(s) / material.cs, complex(s) / material.cp
    zs, zp = ks * r, kp * r
    k0s, k1s, k0p, k1p = kv(0, zs), kv(1, zs), kv(0, zp), kv(1, zp)
    f1 = -ks * k1s + kp * k1p
    f2 = ks * ks * k0s - kp * kp * k0p - f1 / r
    f3 = -(ks**3) * k1s + kp**3 * k1p - f2 / r + f1 / r**2
    small = np.maximum(np.abs(zs), np.abs(zp)) < 0.2
    if np.any(small):
        d1, d2, d3 = _difference_derivatives_series(r[small], ks, kp)
        f1[small], f2[small], f3[small] = d1, d2, d3
    a = k0s - f1 / (ks * ks * r)
    b = -(f2 - f1 / r) / (ks * ks)
    da = -ks * k1s - (f2 / r - f1 / r**2) / (ks * ks)
    db = -(f3 - f2 / r + f1 / r**2) / (ks * ks)
    scale = 1 / (2 * np.pi * material.mu)
    result = (a * scale, b * scale, da * scale, db * scale)
    if scalars:
        return (*result, k0s / (2 * np.pi), k0p / (2 * np.pi), f1 / (2 * np.pi))
    return result


def _tensor_from_radial(vector, r, a, b, da, db):
    e = vector / r[..., None]
    eye = np.eye(2)
    tensor = a[..., None, None] * eye + np.einsum("..., ...i,...j->...ij", b, e, e)
    gradient = np.einsum("...,...k,ij->...kij", da, e, eye)
    gradient += np.einsum("...,...k,...i,...j->...kij", db, e, e, e)
    gradient += (b / r)[..., None, None, None] * (
        np.einsum("ik,...j->...kij", eye, e)
        + np.einsum("jk,...i->...kij", eye, e)
        - 2 * np.einsum("...k,...i,...j->...kij", e, e, e)
    )
    return tensor, gradient


def green_and_gradient(vector, s, material: ElasticMaterial):
    vector = np.asarray(vector, dtype=float)
    if vector.shape[-1:] != (2,) or not np.all(np.isfinite(vector)):
        raise ValueError("Expected finite 2D separation vectors")
    if not np.isfinite(s) or np.real(s) <= 0:
        raise ValueError("Laplace parameter must have positive real part")
    r = np.linalg.norm(vector, axis=-1)
    if np.any(r <= 0):
        raise ValueError("The fundamental solution is singular at zero separation")
    # Flattening also supports one separation vector without scalar indexing.
    shape = r.shape
    flat = r.reshape(-1)
    radial = [x.reshape(shape) for x in _radial(flat, s, material)]
    return _tensor_from_radial(vector, r, *radial)


def static_green_and_gradient(vector, material: ElasticMaterial, reference_length=1.0):
    vector = np.asarray(vector, dtype=float)
    r = np.linalg.norm(vector, axis=-1)
    if np.any(r <= 0) or reference_length <= 0:
        raise ValueError("Positive separation and reference length are required")
    factor = 1 / (8 * np.pi * material.mu * (1 - material.poisson))
    kappa = 3 - 4 * material.poisson
    a = -factor * kappa * np.log(r / reference_length)
    b = np.full_like(r, factor)
    da, db = -factor * kappa / r, np.zeros_like(r)
    return _tensor_from_radial(vector, r, a, b, da, db)


def source_traction(gradient, normals, material: ElasticMaterial):
    """Double-layer tensor D_ij = (T_y G_i)_j, not its transpose."""
    normals = np.asarray(normals)
    divergence = np.einsum("...kik->...i", gradient)
    directional = np.einsum("...k,...kij->...ij", normals, gradient)
    second = np.einsum("...k,...jik->...ij", normals, gradient)
    return material.lam * divergence[..., :, None] * normals[..., None, :] + material.mu * (
        directional + second
    )

"""Prepared, batched evaluation of the reference symmetric Galerkin integrals.

Geometry is shared read-only by frequency workers. Each worker streams bounded
pair batches. The quadrature, singularity subtraction and bilinear reciprocity
are identical to galerkin.py; no approximation is introduced here.
"""

from dataclasses import dataclass

import numpy as np

from .galerkin import ROTATION, GalerkinOperators, _basis, _pair_rule
from .kernels import _radial, _tensor_from_radial, source_traction, static_green_and_gradient


def prepared_geometry_bytes(mesh, quadrature):
    """Conservative bound including cached geometry, indices and construction copies."""
    n = mesh.count
    pairs = n * (n + 1) // 2
    points = (pairs + n) * quadrature**2
    return points * 96 + pairs * 4096


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class _PairBatch:
    i: np.ndarray
    j: np.ndarray
    vector: np.ndarray
    measure: np.ndarray
    px: np.ndarray
    py: np.ndarray
    dx: np.ndarray
    dy: np.ndarray
    nx: np.ndarray
    ny: np.ndarray
    angular: np.ndarray
    log: np.ndarray
    integral: np.ndarray
    log_moment: np.ndarray
    vindices: np.ndarray
    hindices: np.ndarray
    reverse_hindices: np.ndarray
    dindices: np.ndarray
    self_pair: bool


class PreparedGalerkinOperators:
    """Reuse a closed loop's P1/P0 quadrature geometry over many frequencies."""

    def __init__(self, mesh, material, *, quadrature=12, batch_pairs=32):
        if not isinstance(quadrature, int) or quadrature < 4 or quadrature % 2:
            raise ValueError("Use an even Gauss order of at least 4")
        if not isinstance(batch_pairs, int) or batch_pairs < 1:
            raise ValueError("batch_pairs must be a positive integer")
        self.mesh, self.material = mesh, material
        self.reference = max(np.ptp(mesh.starts, axis=0).max(), 1.0)
        n = mesh.count
        self.mass = np.zeros((mesh.dofs, mesh.dofs))
        for i in range(n):
            for endpoint in [i, (i + 1) % n]:
                self.mass[2 * i : 2 * i + 2, 2 * endpoint : 2 * endpoint + 2] += (
                    mesh.lengths[i] / 2 * np.eye(2)
                )
        groups = [[], [], []]  # self, adjacent, disjoint: fixed quadrature sizes
        for i in range(n):
            for j in range(i, n):
                kind = 0 if i == j else (1 if j == i + 1 or (i == 0 and j == n - 1) else 2)
                groups[kind].append((i, j))
        self.batches = []
        for pairs in groups:
            for first in range(0, len(pairs), batch_pairs):
                self.batches.append(self._prepare(pairs[first : first + batch_pairs], quadrature))
        # Prevent accidental writes when this instance is shared by workers.
        self.mass.flags.writeable = False
        for batch in self.batches:
            for value in vars(batch).values():
                if isinstance(value, np.ndarray):
                    value.flags.writeable = False

    def _prepare(self, pairs, order):
        mesh = self.mesh
        i, j = np.array(pairs).T
        rules = [_pair_rule(mesh, int(a), int(b), order) for a, b in pairs]
        x, y, measure = [np.stack([r[k] for r in rules]) for k in range(3)]
        px, py = _basis(x.ravel()).reshape(*x.shape, 2), _basis(y.ravel()).reshape(*y.shape, 2)
        vector = mesh.starts[j, None] + y[..., None] * (mesh.ends[j] - mesh.starts[j])[:, None]
        vector -= mesh.starts[i, None] + x[..., None] * (mesh.ends[i] - mesh.starts[i])[:, None]
        dx, dy = (
            np.array([-1.0, 1.0]) / mesh.lengths[i, None],
            np.array([-1.0, 1.0]) / mesh.lengths[j, None],
        )
        nx, ny, ty = mesh.normals[i], mesh.normals[j], mesh.tangents[j]
        angular = -np.sum(nx * ny, axis=1)[:, None, None] * np.eye(2)
        angular += np.sum(nx * ty, axis=1)[:, None, None] * ROTATION
        self_pair = bool(i[0] == j[0])
        log = np.zeros_like(x)
        integral = np.zeros(len(pairs))
        moments = np.zeros((len(pairs), 2, 2))
        if self_pair:
            log = np.log(np.linalg.norm(vector, axis=2) / self.reference)
            length = mesh.lengths[i]
            integral = length**2 * (np.log(length / self.reference) - 1.5)
            moments = length[:, None, None] ** 2 * (
                np.log(length / self.reference)[:, None, None] / 4
                + np.array([[-7.0, -5.0], [-5.0, -7.0]]) / 16
            )
        elif rules[0][3] is not None:
            log = np.stack([r[3] for r in rules])
            integral = -mesh.lengths[i] * mesh.lengths[j] / 2
            moments = np.stack([r[4] for r in rules])
        row, col = 2 * i[:, None] + np.arange(2), 2 * j[:, None] + np.arange(2)
        idofs = (2 * np.column_stack((i, (i + 1) % mesh.count))[:, :, None] + np.arange(2)).reshape(
            -1, 4
        )
        jdofs = (2 * np.column_stack((j, (j + 1) % mesh.count))[:, :, None] + np.arange(2)).reshape(
            -1, 4
        )

        def indices(a, b):
            return a[:, :, None] * mesh.dofs + b[:, None, :]

        return _PairBatch(
            i,
            j,
            vector,
            measure,
            px,
            py,
            dx,
            dy,
            nx,
            ny,
            angular,
            log,
            integral,
            moments,
            indices(row, col),
            indices(row, jdofs),
            indices(col, idofs),
            indices(idofs, jdofs),
            self_pair,
        )

    def assemble(self, s=None):
        if s is not None and (not np.isfinite(s) or np.real(s) <= 0):
            raise ValueError("Laplace parameter must have positive real part")
        material, n = self.material, self.mesh.dofs
        mu, lam = material.mu, material.lam
        log_green = -(lam + 3 * mu) / (4 * np.pi * mu * (lam + 2 * mu))
        log_derivative = 4 * mu**2 * (log_green + 1 / (2 * np.pi * (lam + 2 * mu)))
        effective_s = 0.0 if s is None else complex(s)
        vmat = np.zeros((n, n), dtype=float if s is None else complex)
        hmat, dmat = vmat.copy(), vmat.copy()
        for b in self.batches:
            p, q = b.measure.shape
            vector = b.vector.reshape(-1, 2)
            r = np.linalg.norm(vector, axis=1)
            if s is None:
                green, gradient = static_green_and_gradient(vector, material, self.reference)
                gs = gp = -np.log(r / self.reference) / (2 * np.pi)
                difference, gradient_y = np.zeros_like(r), np.zeros_like(vector)
            else:
                a, radial_b, da, db, gs, gp, dr = _radial(r, s, material, scalars=True)
                green, gradient = _tensor_from_radial(vector, r, a, radial_b, da, db)
                difference, gradient_y = gs - gp, vector * (dr / r)[:, None]
            green = green.reshape(p, q, 2, 2)
            gradient = gradient.reshape(p, q, 2, 2, 2)
            double = source_traction(gradient, b.ny[:, None], material)
            reverse = source_traction(-gradient, b.nx[:, None], material)
            gs, gp, difference = [a.reshape(p, q) for a in (gs, gp, difference)]
            gradient_y = gradient_y.reshape(p, q, 2)
            green = green - log_green * b.log[..., None, None] * np.eye(2)
            gs, gp = gs + b.log / (2 * np.pi), gp + b.log / (2 * np.pi)
            mass = (
                -material.density
                * effective_s**2
                * (
                    difference[..., None, None] * (b.nx[:, :, None] * b.ny[:, None, :])[:, None]
                    + gs[..., None, None] * b.angular[:, None]
                )
            )
            deriv = 4 * mu**2 * (green - gp[..., None, None] * np.eye(2) / (lam + 2 * mu))
            left = -2 * mu * b.nx[:, None, :, None] * (gradient_y @ ROTATION)[:, :, None, :]
            right = -2 * mu * (gradient_y @ ROTATION.T)[:, :, :, None] * b.ny[:, None, None, :]
            local_d = np.einsum("pq,pqab,pqi,pqj->piajb", b.measure, mass, b.px, b.py)
            local_d += np.einsum("pq,pqab,pi,pj->piajb", b.measure, deriv, b.dx, b.dy)
            local_d += np.einsum("pq,pqab,pqi,pj->piajb", b.measure, left, b.px, b.dy)
            local_d += np.einsum("pq,pqab,pi,pqj->piajb", b.measure, right, b.dx, b.py)
            local_v = np.einsum("pq,pqab->pab", b.measure, green)
            if b.self_pair:
                local_v *= 2
                local_d += local_d.transpose(0, 3, 4, 1, 2)
            local_v += log_green * b.integral[:, None, None] * np.eye(2)
            local_d += np.einsum(
                "p,pi,pj,ab->piajb", log_derivative * b.integral, b.dx, b.dy, np.eye(2)
            )
            angular = -np.broadcast_to(np.eye(2), b.angular.shape) if b.self_pair else b.angular
            local_d += np.einsum(
                "pij,pab->piajb",
                material.density * effective_s**2 / (2 * np.pi) * b.log_moment,
                angular,
            )
            local_k = np.einsum(
                "pq,pqab,pqi->paib", b.measure, double, b.py - b.px if b.self_pair else b.py
            ).reshape(p, 2, 4)
            np.add.at(vmat.ravel(), b.vindices, local_v)
            np.add.at(hmat.ravel(), b.hindices, local_k)
            np.add.at(dmat.ravel(), b.dindices, local_d.reshape(p, 4, 4))
            if not b.self_pair:
                # Transposed global matrix indices, not a post-hoc symmetrization.
                np.add.at(vmat.ravel(), (b.vindices % n) * n + b.vindices // n, local_v)
                np.add.at(
                    dmat.ravel(), (b.dindices % n) * n + b.dindices // n, local_d.reshape(p, 4, 4)
                )
                local_reverse = np.einsum("pq,pqab,pqi->paib", b.measure, reverse, b.px).reshape(
                    p, 2, 4
                )
                np.add.at(hmat.ravel(), b.reverse_hindices, local_reverse)
        hmat += 0.5 * self.mass
        return GalerkinOperators(vmat, hmat, dmat, self.mass)
